crash_body: The app hit a problem and we have been told about it. Tap Reload to continue.
signin_intro: Sign in with your mobile number. We send a code by SMS.
join_intro: Enter your mobile number to start. You will get a code by SMS.
join_cta: New here? Join as On-call Reliever
otp_note: We send a one-time code by SMS. No password needed.
save_app_hint: Open it from your home screen next time
install_title: Save iSmart On-call on your phone
install_body: It will appear on your home screen and open like any other app.
ios_step2: Tap Share at the bottom of the screen.
ios_step3: Tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
android_step2: Tap Install app or Add to Home screen.
android_step3: Tap Install. The iSmart On-call icon appears on your home screen.
install_chrome_hint: Don't see it? Open oncall.ismartfacitech.com in Google Chrome and try again.
err_otp: Enter the 6-digit code from the SMS.
err_slow: The network is slow — please try again.
err_offline: No internet connection — please try again.
err_too_many: Too many tries — wait a minute and try again.
err_generic: Something went wrong — please try again.
err_upload: The file didn't upload — check your internet and try again.
err_upload_status: The file didn't upload ({status}) — please try again.
err_location_blocked: Location is blocked. Allow location for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
err_location_failed: Couldn't get your location — turn on GPS, move near a window and try again.
err_no_geolocation: This browser can't share your location.
err_file_big: This file is too big. Use a file under 10 MB.
err_file_read: That photo couldn't be read — please take it again.
join_not_registered: {mobile} is not registered yet. Register in 4 steps — it takes about 5 minutes.
join_already_registered: This is already registered as {code}. Sign in with the mobile number used for {code}.
oc_name_intro: Registering mobile +91 {mobile}. Enter your name exactly as it is on your Aadhaar card.
oc_err_name: Enter your full name as on Aadhaar
oc_aadhaar_intro: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number. We check that it is a valid Aadhaar.
oc_err_aadhaar: Enter all 12 digits of your Aadhaar number
oc_bank_intro: Your payment is sent to this account. Then upload a photo of your passbook or a cancelled cheque.
oc_err_acc: Account number must be 9 to 18 digits
oc_err_acc_match: The two account numbers don't match
oc_bank_manual: Bank account saved — it will be checked from your passbook
oc_passbook_hint: Photo or PDF showing your name and account number
oc_photo_intro: Take a clear selfie facing the camera — no cap or sunglasses. This is your ID photo.
photo_geotag_note: Your location and the time are printed on the photo.
join_done_body: Sign in with this mobile number at the site to check in. Operations check every day and pay you for it.
inactive_body: Your on-call registration {code} is inactive. Please contact the operations team.
sign_out_body: You will need a new SMS code to sign in again.
perm_intro: Two permissions are needed to check you in at a site.
perm_location_why: Finds the sites near you and records where you checked in.
perm_camera_why: Takes a photo at check-in and check-out, with the time and place on it.
perm_blocked: Permission is blocked. Tap the lock icon next to the address (or the browser's site settings), allow it, then tap Try again.
check_in_sub: Pick your site and take a photo
no_checkins_home: No check-ins yet. Your days show up here.
end_work_body: You have worked {time} at {site}. Check out only when you are leaving — you will take a photo next.
attendance_note: Operations check every day. Approved days are paid.
help_1: When you reach the site, tap Clock in / out, pick the site and take a photo. The photo shows your ID, the site, the time and your location.
help_2: When you leave, tap the card again to check out with a photo.
help_3: Operations check each day and match it to the absent employee you covered. Approved days are paid at your daily rate.
site_verification_body: Pick the site you were sent to. Operations check every check-in against the photo and location.
no_sites: No site found within 2 km. Search for it by name below.
photo_intro_in: At {site}. Take a clear photo of yourself at the site.
photo_intro_out: Leaving {site}. Take a photo at the site as you check out.
photo_stamp_note: The time, site and your location are printed on the photo.
check_details_out: Check the details, then check out.
checked_in_body: Have a good day at work. Check out here when you leave.
checked_out_body: Thanks for today. Operations will check and approve the day.
cam_unsupported: This browser can't open the camera here — use Phone camera.
cam_blocked: The camera didn't open. Allow camera for this site, or use Phone camera.
cam_hint: Keep your face and the site in the frame
bank_confirm_body: Your bank sent these details. Check that the account is in your name.
bank_name_mismatch: The name on this account doesn't match {name}. Payment is sent only to your own account.
